name: sheets-generator
//released: Shown in the page footer so a copy can be identified. Set by hand with the version - NOT from the clock, because CI rebuilds and fails on any diff, so a wall-clock stamp would break every run.
//analyser: The diagram analyser is its own tool with its own history, so it carries its own version and does NOT inherit the berthing sheets'. Stamping it 2.6.0 would claim five releases it never had, and a fault reported against 'version 2.6' would be ambiguous between two different files. Same rule as above: set by hand, never from the clock.
description: Unit berthing sheets from Genius reports and weekend diagram prints, and a fleet analysis of the same prints — two single offline HTML files.
